stem.text: Propanone reacts with an aqueous mixture of $\text{HCN}$ and $\text{NaCN}$ by a nucleophilic addition mechanism.
The first stage of the mechanism involves attack by cyanide ions.

A.alt: Mechanism: cyanide ion NC with negative charge and lone pair on carbon; curly arrow with arrowhead on the cyanide side, starting at the carbonyl carbon of propanone; delta+ on C, delta- on O

B.alt: Mechanism: cyanide ion NC with negative charge and lone pair on carbon; curly arrow with arrowhead on the cyanide side, starting at the carbonyl carbon of propanone; delta+ on C, delta- on O

C.alt: Mechanism: curly arrow from a lone pair on N of the cyanide ion CN (negative charge) to the carbonyl carbon of propanone; delta+ on C, delta- on O

D.alt: Mechanism: curly arrow from the lone pair on C of the cyanide ion NC (negative charge) to the carbonyl carbon of propanone; delta+ on C, delta- on O
